reviews.text: The Travel Sitter took great care of my guys and my home. She also fixed some things around the house that I kept putting off!

I had such a great experience leaving my fur baby in Nicki’s hands. She’s an excellent communicator and did a wonderful job keeping his schedule. I also received photos all along the way! I returned home to a happy dog and a clean house! I can’t say thank you enough for loving my baby as much as I do!

Nicki is the absolute best!!!!!! My babies loved her from the start, even my girl that has major trust issues. She sends regular pupdates, caring for your fur babies and home just like she would her own. I will MOST DEFINITELY be utilizing her services every chance we get!!

Nicki has sat for us once so far and our experience was exceptional. She took wonderful care of our four dogs, and made sure to check in with us regularly while we were gone, sending pictures and making sure we were updated on how they were doing. She handled all the complicated food/medication/supplements steps for four very demanding animals perfectly. She watered the plants and brought in packages and mail, and washed the sheets and dog bowls before she left. We really could not have asked for more. I recommend her services without hesitation!

We are so grateful for Nicki! She truly saved the day when our original sitter had to cancel last minute, and she was able to step in for an overnight stay with Champ. From the moment we met her, her kindness and great energy put us at ease. She took wonderful care of Champ, keeping him happy and comfortable, and we came home to a house that was even cleaner than when we left. It’s such a relief to know Champ was in such good hands—we couldn’t recommend Nicki more highly!

I recently had the pleasure of having Nicki care for my 15 year old dog, Sammy,  while I was away, and I cannot express how impressed I was with her service. From the moment we met, Nicki's professionalism shone through. I was extremely nervous to leave Sammy.  She provided excellent communication throughout my time away, sending regular updates and photos of my buddy that truly put my mind at ease. It was clear that she not only understood the needs of my dog but also genuinely cared for his well-being. I came home to a happy and well-cared-for pet, and I am incredibly grateful for Nicki’s dedication and reliability. I highly recommend her services to anyone in need of a trustworthy pet and house sitter.

The TRAVEL SITTER is AMAZING!
STOP SEARCHING NOW AND RESERVE!!!

We want to let everyone know that Nikki is an awesome human. She is a professional.  This is her career. She is honest and dependable. Nikki is a caring person and the service she offers is an answer to your traveling prayers🙏🏻We just returned from a 10 day trip after reserving Nikki for our FIRST time. Everything she says and offers is true. She arrives in her personalized RV and is willing to stay there and check the house and pets numerous times or she can stay in your home while you are away. So really she watches your house and your furbabies. Her cost is comparable to boarding and your furbabies are able to stay in their home safe and secure with Nikki. We loved knowing they were not kenneled up. Nikki sent us pictures of the babies many times on our trip and they were always chill and relaxed.😎 I even placed a grocery delivery for our return date and she willfully put everything in place. Reserving Nikki is the best gift you can give yourself while you travel. 🧳 She is the REAL DEAL!!! I can recommend her and we look forward to our next travel thanks to NIKKI💕
Our goto for home and dog.

Nicki is truly AMAZING!! She is an outstanding human who goes above and beyond for our two fur babies and all house related matters.

I found her on next door a little over a year ago and not sure how we ever traveled without her. She has built quite the reputation in our neighborhood and you’re lucky to get on her schedule!!

We will always support Nicki, there’s no one like her. Call her, you won’t regret it!
Nicki has been our go to for a couple of years. Our dogs love her. She has been a great house and dog sitter. After we we gone for 2 weeks, they were sad to see Nicki leave.  The best!

Nicki was amazing! She took care of my plants and pool and even took care of chores. She was professional and prompt and gave us peace of mind to leave our home in her hands. Thank you Nicki for everything.

Nicki is one of a kind!! She is professional, full of energy, and treats our fur babies just like her own! She watched the house and our crazy boxers for a week and we have already booked her again! Highly recommend! (Photo of our 2 snoozing with Nicki’s sweet baby Quito)
